question: Does the frozen FoundPose-inspired layer-18 local-only ranking plus unchanged multiscale proposals and native SAM2 localize wholly new physical door 8 at IoU at least 0.5 in all three frozen query views?

evaluation.truth_role: Provider truth enters only after frozen local-only ranking and SAM refinement.

literature_motivation.use: Intermediate DINOv2 features preserve stronger spatial identity under semantic appearance ambiguity.
Query-directed foreground patch matching and SAM refinement.

forbidden_after_freeze: change layer, local score, final-layer template choice, tie breaks, proposal roster, SAM or IoU gate
add geometry, position, sibling or query-truth ranking terms
retry, replace a frame or add post-outcome rescue
claim_boundary: A pass can establish only narrow same-provider new-family confirmation that the frozen layer-18 local-only pipeline acquires and localizes one bound physical door from full query frames. Same-provider geometry selected reference boxes. It cannot establish calibrated open-set absence, broad distractor coverage, raw-phone or provider-independent generalization, named entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
